confidence_rationale: The canonical statement of the binding problem and the claim that conjoining separable features into a coherent object REQUIRES focal attention -- pre-attentive feature maps are registered in parallel but their conjunction is a serial, attention-gated act. This directly grounds ARC-006's design constraint that 'binding is attention-gated' (entities_and_binding.md), the single most load-bearing and most-cited part of ARC-006. Discounted from the top band because illusory conjunctions and serial conjunction search are behavioural signatures whose strict serial/parallel dichotomy was later softened (Wolfe's Guided Search, the 2019 40-years retrospective), and because the theory is about within-moment perceptual binding, not the across-time persistence ARC-006 also asserts.
failure_signatures: The strict serial-conjunction / parallel-feature dichotomy was empirically softened by later work (Guided Search; the 2019 special issue); a REE binding stage modelled as a hard serial bottleneck would over-commit to the 1980 form of the theory.

FIT addresses within-moment feature CONJUNCTION (what binds into one object now), not across-time entity PERSISTENCE (whether it is the same object later) -- so it grounds ARC-006's binding clause but not its persistence clause (Kahneman/Scholl entries carry persistence).

Illusory conjunctions show binding can FAIL without attention -- a REE system that merges features feedforward without an attention/precision gate would predict mis-binding the theory says should occur.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Separable features (colour, orientation, etc.) are registered automatically and in parallel across pre-attentive feature maps, but combining them into the correct conjunction for a coherent object requires focal attention directed serially to each location; without attention, features can recombine into illusory conjunctions.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-006's design constraints state 'binding is attention-gated -- feature binding should depend on precision/attention state rather than a purely feedforward merge.' FIT is the foundational evidence and theoretical source for that constraint: it establishes that correct binding is not free, that it is gated by an attentional resource, and that ungated binding mis-binds. For REE this licenses making entity formation depend on a precision/attention signal rather than a feedforward concatenation of latents.
mapping.mapping_caveat: FIT concerns within-moment perceptual feature conjunction in human vision; ARC-006 additionally claims across-time persistence and error-ownership, which FIT does not address. The strict serial-search account has been revised; the durable, well-supported core that transfers is the weaker claim 'correct binding requires an attention/precision gate', not the specific serial-scan mechanism.
mapping.source_context: Human visual psychophysics; feature vs conjunction visual search, texture segregation, and illusory-conjunction report tasks.

confidence_components.notes: Foundational and heavily cited; mapping to the attention-gated-binding constraint is strong. Discounted because the serial-search specifics were later revised and FIT does not cover persistence.
